title_tag_present.title: Title Tag Present & Defined
title_tag_present.explain: The title tag is one of the most critical on-page ranking signals for search engines and user click-through rate.
title_tag_present.fix: Add a unique <title> tag inside the <head> section containing your primary keyword.

title_length.title: Title Tag Character & Pixel Length
title_length.explain: Optimal title length is 50-60 characters (< 600px width). Longer titles get truncated in search results.
title_length.fix: Shorten or refine your <title> to be between 50 and 60 characters.

meta_description_present.title: Meta Description Tag Present
meta_description_present.explain: A well-crafted meta description improves click-through rate (CTR) from the search engine results page.
meta_description_present.fix: Add <meta name="description" content="..."> with a compelling summary under 160 characters.

meta_description_length.title: Meta Description Length (120-160 chars)
meta_description_length.explain: Descriptions between 120 and 160 characters provide enough context without being truncated on desktop or mobile.
meta_description_length.fix: Adjust meta description to fit within 120-160 characters.

h1_count.title: Single H1 Heading
h1_count.explain: Every page should have exactly one H1 heading that clearly communicates the main topic of the page.
h1_count.fix: Ensure the page has exactly one <h1> heading near the top of the body.

heading_hierarchy.title: Logical Heading Hierarchy
heading_hierarchy.explain: Heading levels should not skip steps (e.g. H1 directly to H3) for accessibility and crawl structure.
heading_hierarchy.fix: Structure headings sequentially without skipping levels (H1 -> H2 -> H3).

image_alt_coverage.title: Image Alt Attribute Coverage
image_alt_coverage.explain: Descriptive alt attributes allow search engines to index images and enable screen readers for accessibility.
image_alt_coverage.fix: Add descriptive alt="..." attributes to all meaningful tags.

image_dimensions.title: Image Width and Height Attributes
image_dimensions.explain: Explicit width and height attributes prevent Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) as images load.
image_dimensions.fix: Add width and height attributes or CSS aspect-ratio to all elements.

content_word_count.title: Substantive Content Depth (Word Count)
content_word_count.explain: Pages with comprehensive, in-depth text content (>600 words) rank more authoritatively for topical queries.
content_word_count.fix: Expand the depth and unique value of the page content to at least 600 words.

readability_score.title: Content Readability (Flesch Reading Ease)
readability_score.explain: Clear, accessible copy with a Flesch score between 50-70 ensures broad user comprehension and engagement.
readability_score.fix: Shorten complex sentences, use simpler vocabulary, and break paragraphs into digestible chunks.

target_keyword_placement.title: Target Keyword Placement in Key Zones
target_keyword_placement.explain: Placing the primary keyword in the Title, H1, first 100 words, and URL reinforces topical relevance.
target_keyword_placement.fix: Incorporate the target keyword naturally in the title tag, H1 heading, and opening paragraph.

anchor_text_quality.title: Descriptive Anchor Text (No Generic Links)
anchor_text_quality.explain: Generic anchor texts like 'click here' or 'read more' give search engines zero context on linked pages.
anchor_text_quality.fix: Replace generic link text with descriptive phrases explaining the target destination.

canonical_tag.title: Canonical Tag Defined
canonical_tag.explain: The canonical link tag prevents duplicate content issues by declaring the primary version of a URL.

meta_robots.title: Meta Robots & Indexing Directives
meta_robots.explain: Verifies whether the page permits indexing and link following without accidental 'noindex' directives.
meta_robots.fix: Remove 'noindex' unless the page is intentionally private or temporary.

jsonld_schema.title: Valid Structured Data (JSON-LD)
jsonld_schema.explain: Schema markup enables rich snippets, knowledge graph entities, and enhanced search results.
jsonld_schema.fix: Add valid schema.org JSON-LD markup describing the entity (Article, Product, Organization, FAQ).

charset_utf8.title: Character Encoding Declared (UTF-8)
charset_utf8.explain: Declaring <meta charset="utf-8"> early in <head> prevents browser rendering bugs and security exploits.
charset_utf8.fix: Add <meta charset="UTF-8"> as the first child of the <head> tag.

doctype_html5.title: Valid HTML5 Doctype
doctype_html5.explain: A standard <!DOCTYPE html> declaration ensures standards-mode rendering across all modern browsers.
doctype_html5.fix: Add <!DOCTYPE html> at the very beginning of the HTML file.

lang_attribute.title: HTML Lang Attribute Declared
lang_attribute.explain: Declaring the language in <html lang="en"> helps search engines and screen readers parse content correctly.
lang_attribute.fix: Add a valid ISO language code to the <html> tag, e.g. <html lang="en">.

favicon_present.title: Favicon Icon Defined
favicon_present.explain: Favicons appear in browser tabs, bookmarks, and Google Mobile search results alongside the snippet.

robots_ai_rules.title: AI Search Crawler Access (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Perplexity)
robots_ai_rules.explain: Verifies that AI search engines and answer engines are permitted to index and cite content.
robots_ai_rules.fix: Ensure robots.txt allows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot.

llms_txt_present.title: LLMs.txt & Machine-Readable Index
llms_txt_present.explain: llms.txt provides a standardized markdown summary for LLM scrapers and agentic search tools.
llms_txt_present.fix: Generate and place an /llms.txt file in the site root explaining key documentation and APIs.

answer_first_formatting.title: Answer-First Structure for AI Snippets
answer_first_formatting.explain: Direct, concise answers within the first 200 words increase citation likelihood in AI Overviews.
answer_first_formatting.fix: Provide a direct 2-3 sentence definition or answer immediately below the main H1/H2.

faq_schema.title: FAQ & Question Schema Markup
faq_schema.explain: FAQ structured data provides explicit Q&A pairs that AI engines can extract directly for answers.
faq_schema.fix: Add FAQPage schema with clearly articulated questions and factual answers.

entity_clarity.title: Named Entity Clarity & sameAs References
entity_clarity.explain: Explicit entity markup with sameAs links to Wikipedia, LinkedIn, or Wikidata helps AI knowledge graphs.
entity_clarity.fix: Include Organization or Person schema with verified sameAs authority URLs.
